name: B1: AdaGN Noise Conditioning in AR FrameDecoder
theory: Investigation 2 proved AdaGN is THE rank amplifier (1→22.7 in Conv3D). AR MLP crushes rank to 1.06 via additive concatenation. Replace concat with multiplicative scale+shift after each SiLU.
target: Cross-cell correlation (Suite 2 root cause), factor structure
prediction: Effective noise rank increases from 1.06 toward GT 2.6. Cross-cell corr decreases.
implementation: After each SiLU in MLP: scale, shift = Linear(noise_emb); h = scale * LayerNorm(h) + shift. 120a.

name: C1: Explicit ACF Loss
theory: Investigation 3+117a: neither VR formulation targets ACF directly. Model deltas have positive lag-1 ACF (+0.16 to +0.83) vs GT (-0.35 to -0.51). Direct ACF penalty: max(0, ACF + 0.25)^2.
target: Mean-reversion (Suite 4 time series), Suite 2 cumulative spread
prediction: ACF shifts negative. Cumulative VR improves. May help Suite 2.
implementation: Compute lag-1 ACF of ensemble deltas, penalize if > -0.25. Lambda sweep 0.1-1.0.

name: C2: Orthogonal Regularization on noise_skip_proj
theory: Investigation 10: skip alignment is SOLE cause of correlation drift from GT-level (0.32 at ep10) to rank-1 (0.44+). Freezing skip (114a) breaks surface validity. Soft ortho penalty avoids this.
prediction: Skip rows stay diverse. Correlation stays near ep10 level (~0.32).
implementation: loss += lambda * mean(|cosine_sim(row_i, row_j)|) for skip weight rows.

name: B2: Noise-Free MLP Path
theory: Investigation 7: MLP Jacobian=-0.74 (mean-reverting!) but noise overwhelms 7.2x. MLP-skip cancellation: MLP learns f(z) ≈ -skip(z). Removing noise from MLP lets natural MR surface.
prediction: MLP mean-reversion emerges. ACF shifts negative. May break kurtosis.
implementation: MLP input = [prev, cond, pos] only (no noise). Noise enters exclusively through skip.

name: D2: 4-Factor + Student-t(df=8) in One-Shot
theory: Investigation 115a: CLT on 3-factor Student-t(6) reduces kurtosis too much (0.487). 4 factors = less CLT smoothing, df=8 = lighter input tails.

name: B3: Hybrid AR + One-Shot Dual Decoder (Training)
theory: Post-hoc hybrid showed CI 97.0%, corr matches GT (0.501 vs 0.505). Joint training could be even better — CRPS on combined ensemble forces architectural diversity.
prediction: Better than post-hoc mixing. Corr stays near GT. CI improves.
implementation: Single model with both decoders. K/2 from each. Single CRPS.

name: C3: Low-Rank Per-Cell Spread (3 Shared Factors)
theory: Investigation 5: independent per-cell spread destroys coherence. Low-rank couples cells through 3 shared factors → preserves spatial structure.
prediction: Better spread coherence. May help Suite 7 regime coverage.

name: D1: Curriculum Noise (Gaussian → Student-t at Freeze)
theory: Investigation 8: per-step Student-t suppresses weights during Phase 1. Curriculum separates MLP development (Gaussian) from regularization (Student-t after freeze).
prediction: Better kurtosis than Student-t throughout. Better MLP development.

name: F2: Full DDIM Backprop + afCRPS
theory: 118b_v2 showed CRPS fine-tuning at t=[20,60] produces diversity (s/m=0.95) but sampling is uncalibrated. Full DDIM backprop would calibrate end-to-end.
prediction: Better calibration than 118b_v2. Potentially competitive with AR.
implementation: Backprop through 5-10 DDIM steps + afCRPS on final output.

name: E3: Multi-Checkpoint Ensemble (108a + 99m_v2 + 111b)
theory: Different architectures have complementary strengths. 17 samples from each → 51 members.
prediction: Best composite score. Tests ceiling of diversity approach.
implementation: Inference only. Load 3 checkpoints, 17 samples each, combine.

name: A4: Principled Encoder Training — VIB
theory: Analysis A proved MSE collapses to rank 2, DDPM prevents via push-pull. VIB explicitly controls information bottleneck: minimize I(input;condition) while maximizing I(condition;target).
target: Replace DDPM encoder with principled alternative
prediction: Better factor structure if beta tuned correctly.
implementation: New encoder training loop with KL + reconstruction loss.
